title: Set 11

sentences.ko: 알람을 세 개나 맞춰 놨는데 하나도 못 들었어. 마지막 건 자다가 그냥 껐나 봐. 눈 떠 보니까 벌써 8시 40분이더라고.
sentences.text: I set three alarms and slept through every one of them. I think I turned the last one off in my sleep, because it was already 8:40 when I woke up.

alts.text: Slept through all three alarms. Pretty sure I killed the last one in my sleep, because next thing I knew it was 8:40.
I set three alarms and slept through all of them. I believe I turned the last one off in my sleep, as it was already 8:40 when I woke up.

sentences.note: **slept through** 는 소리가 났는데도 못 듣고 계속 잤다는 뜻이다. **in my sleep** 은 자면서 무의식중에 한 행동을 말할 때 쓴다.

sentences.ko: 넷플릭스만 사십 분을 뒤지다가 결국 아무것도 못 봤잖아. 아무거나 괜찮다며. 그래 놓고 내가 고르는 건 다 싫다고 하고.
sentences.text: We spent forty minutes scrolling and ended up watching nothing. You said you were fine with anything, and then you shot down every single thing I picked.

alts.text: Forty minutes of scrolling and nothing to show for it. You were the one who said anything works, then you shot down everything I picked.
We spent forty minutes browsing and never chose anything. You said you would be happy with any option, and then you rejected every one of my suggestions.

sentences.note: **shot down** 은 남이 낸 의견을 딱 잘라 거절하는 것이다. **ended up watching nothing** 처럼 ended up 은 이러다 저러다 결국 그렇게 됐다는 뜻이다.

sentences.ko: 3월에 기타 사 놓고 네 번인가 쳐 봤나. 4월부터 방구석에 그냥 세워져만 있는데 아직도 사람들한테는 기타 친다고 하고 다녀.
sentences.text: I bought a guitar in March and played it maybe four times. It's been sitting in the corner of my room since April, and I still tell people I play.

alts.text: Got a guitar in March and touched it maybe four times. It's been collecting dust since April, but I still tell people I play.
I purchased a guitar in March and have since played it perhaps four times. It has been sitting in the corner of my room since April, and I still tell people that I play.

sentences.note: **collecting dust** 는 안 쓰고 처박혀 먼지만 쌓인다는 뜻이다. 물건이 어디 놓인 채 방치돼 있을 때 **sitting in the corner** 라고 한다.

sentences.ko: 회사 앞 커피가 이제 4달러 50센트야. 봄에는 3달러 25센트였는데. 그래서 요즘은 집에서 내려다가 보온병에 담아 다녀.
sentences.text: A coffee near my office is $4.50 now. It was $3.25 in the spring, so I've started making mine at home and bringing it in a thermos.

alts.text: Coffee by my office went up to $4.50. It was $3.25 in the spring, so now I just make it at home and bring a thermos.
A cup of coffee near my office now costs $4.50. It was $3.25 in the spring, so I have begun brewing my own at home and carrying it in a thermos.

sentences.note: 값이 올랐다고 할 때 **went up to** 뒤에 지금 가격을 붙인다. 예전 값은 **It was $3.25 in the spring** 처럼 그냥 과거형으로 이어 말하면 된다.

sentences.ko: 1월 이후로 처음 헬스장에 갔는데 예전에 하던 대로 다 해 버렸거든. 이틀 뒤에는 팔이 안 올라가서 머리도 못 감았어.
sentences.text: I went back to the gym for the first time since January and did everything I used to do. Two days later I couldn't lift my arms to wash my hair.

alts.text: First gym day since January and I jumped straight back into my old routine. Couldn't even wash my hair two days later.
I returned to the gym for the first time since January and performed my entire former routine. Two days later I could not raise my arms to wash my hair.

sentences.note: 얼마 만인지는 **for the first time since January** 처럼 since 뒤에 시점을 붙여 말한다. 예전에 늘 하던 것은 **I used to do** 라고 한다.

reviewed: 2번 캐주얼이 지난 일을 현재 습관(You keep saying you don't care)으로 바꿔 놓아 본문의 과거 시제와 어긋났다. 과거로 되돌리고 앞부분은 겹치지 않게 다시 썼다.
3번 격식체의 in March ... have played 는 시점이 못 박힌 과거와 현재완료가 부딪힌다. have since played 로 다듬었다.
4번 캐주얼의 make a thermos 는 원어민이 쓰지 않는 말이다(보온병을 만드는 게 아니다). make it at home and bring a thermos 로 고쳤다.
5번 격식체의 attempted 는 해 보려다 만 느낌이 섞여 본문의 다 해 버렸다와 뜻이 달라진다. performed 로 바꿨다.
